title: F420-based Fluorescence-Activated Cell Sorting of Sedimentary Microbes
author: Jeemin Rhim
materials: Immediately before amplification, thaw sorted samples at 42ºC.
Alternatively, whole genome amplification can be done using a different kit (e.g., QIAGEN® REPLI-g® Single Cell Kit).

steps.title: Collect and Store Sediment Samples
steps.instruction: Collect sediment samples (e.g., marine sediment core samples). Store at 4ºC until cell extraction; do not freeze or add fixatives.

steps.title: Prepare DNA-Free Working Environment
steps.instruction: Decontaminate all working surfaces and pipettes to ensure a DNA-free environment.

substeps.instruction: Wipe surfaces and pipettes in order: 70% ethanol, 10% bleach, and ultrapure water.
Optionally, clean with DNA AWAY™ surface decontaminant.
Use new PCR-grade pipette tips.
UV-crosslink all 2-mL tubes used for amplification for at least 30-60 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Sediment Slurries
steps.instruction: Create sediment slurries in 15-mL conical bottom centrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add ~1 g of sediment to a 15-mL conical bottom centrifuge tube.
Add glycerol-TE to a final concentration of ~5.5%.
Add 5 mL of sterile 3X PBS.
Gently invert tubes to mix sediment and PBS.

steps.title: Extract Cells via Ultrasonication
steps.instruction: Release cells from the sediment using ultrasonication and further dilution.

substeps.instruction: Place 15-mL tubes in a rack in an ice bath.
Ultrasonicate for 2 x 20-second cycles at 7-10 Watts.
Top off each tube with an additional 5 mL of 3X PBS (total 10 mL 3X PBS and ~1 g sediment).
Vortex the slurries for 10 seconds.
Allow slurries to settle on ice for 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Nycodenz Density Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Separate cells from the sediment supernatant using a Nycodenz layer.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 750 µL of supernatant into four replicate 2-mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Using a 22G needle and 1-mL syringe, add 750 µL of 60% (w/v) Nycodenz to the bottom of each tube.
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 20 minutes at 4ºC.

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Cell Layers
steps.instruction: Recover the cell interface and prepare samples for freezing.

substeps.instruction: Collect the sample supernatant and the 'cell layer' at the interface between the supernatant and Nycodenz layer.
Combine supernatant and cell layers from two replicate tubes into one 2-mL tube (resulting in two tubes per sample, each >1.4 mL).
Optional: Transfer an exact amount of sample into a new 2-mL cryotube.
Mix cryotubes by inverting three times.
Incubate at room temperature for 15-20 minutes.

steps.title: Freeze and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Flash-freeze the prepared samples for long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Flash-freeze cryotubes in liquid nitrogen.
Store at –80ºC until cell sorting.

steps.title: Perform F420-based Cell Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort F420-positive particles using flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Thaw cryotubes at 42ºC immediately before sorting.
Perform cytometric measurements of forward scatter (FSC), side scatter (SSC), and F420 fluorescence (488 nm laser for FSC 488/10 and SSC trigger 488/10; 405 nm laser for F420 fluorescence).
Sort F420-positive particles into a new PCR-clean 2-mL tube (ensure enough for replicate reactions, e.g., 3 µL per 12-µL reaction) or sort single particles into a 96-well or 384-well plate.

steps.title: Clean Sorting Environment
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the sorting chamber and surfaces.

substeps.instruction: Wipe inside surfaces of sorting chamber and working surfaces in order: 70% ethanol, 10% bleach, and ultrapure water.
Optionally, clean with DNA AWAY™ surface decontaminant.

steps.title: Amplify DNA via PTA
steps.instruction: Conduct primary template-directed amplification (PTA) using the ResolveDNA® Whole Genome Amplification Kit with specific modifications.

substeps.instruction: Store sorted samples at –80ºC until amplification.
Conduct 5 freeze-thaw cycles on samples prior to the lysis step.
Increase the duration of the 30ºC isothermal amplification hold from 2.5 hours to ~4 hours.

Include at least one or two negative controls; optionally add 0.12 µL of SYTO™ Green Fluorescent Nucleic Acid Stain (SYTO 9) to the Reaction Mix (final concentration 5 µM) and monitor via real-time PCR, terminating the 30ºC hold at the first sign of fluorescence increase in negative controls.

steps.title: Store Amplified Products
steps.instruction: Store the resulting amplified DNA at –20ºC (or –80ºC for long-term storage) for downstream sequencing.
